technicalNotes: The mass-start pages have 9, 23, 7 and 19 source rows, respectively. Keep official places, sprint points, finish times and statuses independently.

The mass-start sheets omit a lap count. The event page and the AmCup Final table of the official 2025-2026 Long Track Regulations specify 10 laps, and the sheets show two intermediate sprints and 30-point final winners, matching the regulation’s 10-lap scoring.
Keep the literal distinct men’s and women’s mass-start report titles and do not count pair-analysis tables as additional race results.
